response.original_text:
ASH café & restaurant review: quiet spot with good coffee
Titles are generated by AI from Meta
The owner of ASH invited me to visit, so I finally dropped by today. I didn’t tell them I was coming.
I liked the place. It’s quiet, the music is low, the coffee is good, and yes, they have sockets. The table and chair height are also comfortable for working on a laptop, which is something I’m very particular about.
They have Wi-Fi with a voucher too, although I used my mobile data because I’m paranoid about shared Wi-Fi.
I should do this more often. Cabanatuan has so many coffee shops and restaurants now, and some good places simply need more people to know they exist.
